scripts.install-prod: npm install --omit=dev --omit=optional && npm audit fix --omit=dev --omit=optional && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run install-prod
scripts.install-dev: npm install --allow-git=root && npm audit fix --allow-git=root && npx husky && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run install-dev
scripts.lint-front: echo 'Frontend lint not implemented (see mia-core plugin).' && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run lint-front
scripts.lint-tests: echo 'Tests lint not implemented yet.' && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run lint-tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint-back && npm run lint-front && npm run lint-tests
scripts.clean-front: echo 'Clean front not implemented (see mia-core plugin).'
scripts.clean: npm run clean-back && npm run clean-front
scripts.build-back: npm run clean-back && npx tsc --project ./tsconfig.json && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run build-back
scripts.build-front: echo 'Build front not implemented (see mia-core plugin).' && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run build-front
scripts.build: npm run build-back && npm run build-front
scripts.check-requires: npx used-deps-analyzer "./package.json" "./lib/src" --no-dev --shadows @fortawesome/fontawesome-free bootstrap --misscalled "{ \"module\": \"@fortawesome/fontawesome-free\", \"call\": \"@fortawesome\" }" && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run check-requires
scripts.unit-tests: npx c8 --reporter=text-summary --all --include "lib/src/**/*.ts" --include "lib/src/**/*.cts" --exclude "lib/src/Descriptor.ts" --extension .ts --extension .cts --check-coverage --statements 95 --branches 95 --functions 95 --lines 95 mocha --require ./test/register.js && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run unit-tests
scripts.unit-tests-local: npx c8 --reporter=html --reporter=text --all --include "lib/src/**/*.ts" --include "lib/src/**/*.cts" --exclude "lib/src/Descriptor.ts" --extension .ts --extension .cts mocha --require ./test/register.js && npm --prefix ./plugins/mia-core run unit-tests-local
scripts.tests: npm run lint && npm run check-node-engine && npm run check-requires && npm run check-updates && npm run build && npm run unit-tests
scripts.daemon-stop: npx pm2 stop pm2.json && npx pm2 delete pm2.json
scripts.docker-start: docker image build --rm -t image-mia . && docker container run -dti -p 8000:8000 --name container-mia image-mia
scripts.docker-stop: docker container stop container-mia && docker container remove -f container-mia && docker image remove -f image-mia
